sgwt.analytic.analytic_scikit module

Implementation using sksparse. It is slower than the DLL implementation, but can be re-enabled if needed.

class sgwt.analytic.analytic_scikit.FiltersScikit(L, scales=[1])[source]

Bases: AnalyticFilters

Description

A class that of analytical versions filters for SGWT and GSP

Parameters

L: sparse csc_matrix form of Graph Laplacian (real valued) scales: optional, default scales used

Parameters:

L (scipy.sparse.csc_matrix)

scaling_funcs(anchor_indecies, scale)[source]
Returns

Scaling functions of indicated scale using the analytical form.

Parameters

anchor_indicies: nodes at which to return scaling functions scale: scale of the scaling functions

wavelet_funcs(anchor_indecies, scale)[source]
Returns

Wavelet functions of indicated scale using the analytical form. L/(L+I/s)^2

Parameters

anchor_indicies: nodes at which to return wavelets scale: scale of the wavelet

wavelet_inv(W)[source]
Description

The inverse SGWT transformation (only one time point for now) And does not support scaling coefficients right now. Not normalized

Parameters

W: ndarray of shape (Bus x Times x Scales)

Return

f: reconstructed signal
